messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to talk with me about the mobile app modernisation project. To start off, could you tell me what the main goals are for updating the app? What are you hoping to achieve with this project?

Hey! Thanks for having me. So, I guess the main thing is I want the app to feel more modern and quick, like Revolut. I just want to be able to see what's happening with my money instantly, you know? Like, I want to know right away when something comes out of my account, and if I lose my card, I want to freeze it myself without having to call anyone. That would be super helpful!

That sounds great! So, you want the app to have features that provide instant notifications about your money and allow you to freeze your card easily. Could you tell me a bit more about what you mean by "feel more modern"? What specific features do you think would help with that?

Yeah, when I say "feel more modern," I mean it should be fast and easy to use, like I can just tap around without any lag. I think it would be cool to have some sort of breakdown of where my money is going every month too, like, you know, how much I spend on groceries or dining out. And it would be nice to set budgets for different things and get alerts if I'm getting close to going over them. Just stuff that helps me manage my money better without too much hassle.

Thanks for clarifying that! So, it sounds like you want the app to be quick and user-friendly, with features like spending breakdowns and budget alerts to help manage your finances. That makes a lot of sense! 

Could you give me an example of how you imagine the spending breakdown feature working? What kind of information would you like to see?

Sure! I think it would be great if the app could show me a clear overview of what I spent in different categories each month. Like, I’d want to see how much I spent on groceries, dining, transport, and maybe even entertainment. Just something simple that breaks it down so I can see where my money is going at a glance. I don’t want it to be complicated, just easy to understand. That way, I can make better choices about my spending!

Got it! So, the spending breakdown feature should provide a simple and clear overview of expenses by category each month, like groceries, dining, and entertainment. That sounds really useful for managing your spending!

Now, you mentioned wanting alerts for your budgets. Are there any limitations or restrictions on how you would like those alerts to be set up? For example, would you prefer to set your own budget amounts, or should the app suggest amounts for you?

I think it would be best if I could set my own budget amounts. I know my spending habits better than anyone else, so being able to customize that would be really helpful. I just want to get alerts if I'm getting close to my limit or if I've gone over it. That way, I can keep track without having to constantly check. Just a simple notification would do the trick!

That makes a lot of sense! So, you’d like to set your own budget amounts and receive simple notifications if you're close to or over those limits. 

Just to confirm, if I understand correctly, you want the app to have a spending breakdown feature that shows monthly expenses by category, the ability to set custom budgets, and alerts for when you approach or exceed those budgets. 

Are there any other features or functionalities that you think are important for the app to have?

Yeah, that sounds right! Besides those features, I think it would be really helpful if I could easily send money to friends or even to other accounts. Like, just using their phone number or something would make it super convenient. Also, I'd love to have a way to quickly freeze and unfreeze my card if I misplace it, you know? It just adds peace of mind. But mostly, I just want everything to feel smooth and easy to navigate!

Thanks for sharing that! So, you want the app to include a feature for easily sending money to friends using their phone numbers, as well as a quick way to freeze and unfreeze your card. That definitely adds convenience and peace of mind!

To summarize what you've mentioned so far: 
1. A spending breakdown feature that shows monthly expenses by category.
2. The ability to set custom budgets with alerts for approaching or exceeding those limits.
3. A feature to easily send money to friends using their phone numbers.
4. A quick way to freeze and unfreeze your card.

Is that correct? If so, I just need one more requirement to complete our list! Are there any other specific features or functionalities you feel are critical for the modernised app?

Yes, that’s all correct! I think it would also be great if the app had a really easy way to log in, maybe with my fingerprint or face recognition. I just want to get in quickly without having to remember a password or anything like that. It should feel fast and seamless, just like everything else I’ve mentioned!

Perfect! So, you want the app to have an easy login option using fingerprint or face recognition for quick access. 

To summarize all the requirements we have gathered:
1. A spending breakdown feature that shows monthly expenses by category.
2. The ability to set custom budgets with alerts for approaching or exceeding those limits.
3. A feature to easily send money to friends using their phone numbers.
4. A quick way to freeze and unfreeze your card.
5. An easy login option using fingerprint or face recognition.

Thank you so much for sharing your insights today! This really helps us understand the direction for the app.
